from pathlib import Path import sys,json,uuid sys.dont_write_bytecode=True KIT=Path.cwd().resolve() if not (KIT/'edge_api.py').is_file():raise RuntimeError('请从边缘AI包根目录打开此Notebook') sys.path.insert(0,str(KIT)) from edge_package import verify print('固定文件检查:',verify(notebooks=True)) from edge_api import EdgeAI from custom_ai_core import query,TARGETS AI=EdgeAI() print('模型:',AI.model.model_sha256) print('三个目标分别建模；当前只做文件/软件操作，不访问FPGA。') choice=input('目标 1=B完整帧，2=STM载荷，3=STM业务 [1]：').strip() or '1' if choice not in ('1','2','3'):raise ValueError('目标必须是1、2或3') TARGET=TARGETS[int(choice)-1] values=input('d,s,phase,width [3,-1,15,5]：').strip() or '3,-1,15,5' parts=[int(x.strip()) for x in values.split(',')] if len(parts)!=4:raise ValueError('请输入4个整数') D,S,PHASE,WIDTH=parts PREDICTION=AI.predict(query(d=D,s=S,phase=PHASE,width=WIDTH,target=TARGET)) print(json.dumps(PREDICTION,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)) print('score是未校准分数，不是硬件可靠率；prediction为null表示仍需实测。') from edge_api import example_request from custom_ai_core import canonical BUDGET=int(input('预览总预算，含CONFIG和无扰动参照 [14]：').strip() or '14') WORK=KIT.parent/'edge_ai_workspaces'/('preview_'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]) WORK.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False) PREVIEW=AI.compile(example_request(TARGET,D,S,BUDGET)) (WORK/'plan_preview.json').write_bytes(canonical(PREVIEW)) print('计划状态:',PREVIEW['status'],'错误:',PREVIEW.get('errors')) print('仅预览，不授权硬件。完整计划:',WORK/'plan_preview.json') from edge_report import render REPORT=render(WORK/'model_report') print('模型与评估报告:',REPORT) from IPython.display import display,HTML from urllib.parse import quote notebook_root=Path('/home/xilinx/jupyter_notebooks') if notebook_root in REPORT.parents: url='/files/'+quote(REPORT.relative_to(notebook_root).as_posix()) display(HTML('打开或下载只读报告')) print('可下载report.html在电脑打开；CSV/JSON在同目录。没有创建板端试验会话。')
